verdict.rationale: Portkey offers a REST API, self-hostable open-source gateway (npx command, local run), and OpenAI-SDK-compatible base URL swap, all of which support headless/CI usage as an AI gateway. However, there's no explicit CI/automation documentation, CLI tooling for pipelines, or OpenAPI spec confirmed (openapi probes 404), so evidence is inferred from general API/gateway architecture rather than direct CI-focused claims.
